schema.status: COMPLETE | FUNCTIONAL-INCOMPLETE | PARTIAL | PROTOTYPE | UI-ONLY | BACKEND-ONLY | STUB | LEGACY | DEAD | BROKEN | UNKNOWN

features.name: Open a project folder
features.description: Pick a directory via the native dialog; it is validated, canonicalised and recorded as a Project.

features.name: Multiple projects open simultaneously
features.description: Several Projects open in the main window at once; the sidebar lists them all and the active one drives the workspace.

features.name: Project-scoped filesystem containment
features.description: Every filesystem command resolves through ProjectPathGuard bound to the canonical Project root. Rejects .. traversal, NUL bytes, drive/UNC/scheme components; canonicalises and asserts containment so a symlink cannot escape.
issues: Hardening only: guard() reads the project root from the database on every filesystem operation.

features.name: Workspace canvas (dock, split, drag, resize, snap)
features.description: Hand-built pane engine with docking overlays, split resize handles, snapping and geometry maths. Layout is versioned and persisted.

features.name: Exclusive interactive workspace lease
features.description: Only one window may type into a Workspace. claim_workspace_lease issues a token; assert_input_allowed gates terminal input and resize. Leases are runtime-only and die with the process.
issues: A detached window that fails to claim its lease renders output but silently rejects input; whether the UI surfaces this was not verified at runtime.

features.name: PTY terminal sessions
features.description: Real PTY child processes via portable-pty. Bounded output pipeline with drop accounting, exit watcher, machine-protocol geometry for agents, lease-gated input, deterministic teardown.
issues: 5 OS threads per session, two of them pollers (100 ms exit watch, 5 s agent state).
Tests use `echo` as a stand-in; there is no real-PTY test.

features.name: Agent state detection
features.description: Per-session 5 s poller plus an output-signal buffer classify a coding agent as working/idle/waiting; emitted as agent-state.
issues: States derive from output heuristics and a timer rather than a provider contract; accuracy is not verifiable statically.

features.name: Optimistic-concurrency file save
features.description: write_project_file takes expected_sha256; a mismatch returns file_changed_since_read with the current hash instead of clobbering.

features.name: Browser Inspect mode → agent
features.description: An injected script 'navigates' to a synthetic non-resolving host with a base64url payload; the navigation hook intercepts it, emits browser-event, and cancels the navigation so no request is made. The sanitised package is typed into the active pane without a trailing newline.

features.name: 36 typed repository operations
features.description: Stage (incl. hunks via stdin), unstage, restore, branch, checkpoint, commit, amend, fetch, pull, push (--force-with-lease), publish, tag, stash, revert, cherry-pick, rebase, merge, worktree lease/remove, and 13 GitHub operations. Queued, timed out, cancellable, approval-gated and audited.
issues: audit_events.task_id is always NULL because it is validated against the dead mission_tasks table (database/repository.rs:475).

features.name: Repository-native schema implementation
features.description: Approved design → declared current → semantic delta → risk classification → repository-native change (Prisma schema or SQL migration in the repo's existing style) → repository write → re-extraction → independent target-vs-result comparison. DESIGN_ONLY never reaches the write path; destructive changes require acknowledgement of that exact change set.
issues: pipeline/execute.rs and pipeline/native.rs have no mod tests, yet they generate the migrations written into the user's repository.

features.name: Automatic change → impact → staleness loop
features.description: file change → debounced coalescing job → impact report → pure staleness policy (no db, no clock, no model) → memory_mark_stale → memory-knowledge-updated. Records both what it flagged and what it refused to flag, with reasons.

features.name: Context pack compilation
features.description: Retrieval, ranking, token budgeting, citations and staleness handling over the Context Fabric. Purpose-built to supply agents.
issues: Its only consumer is a human preview panel. No agent, swarm or orchestrator path calls it. Agents instead receive ensure_swarm_context_pack (database/swarm.rs:326), a raw ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 8 query with no relevance ranking. This is finding P0-1.

features.name: Code graph (symbols, imports, references)
features.description: Deterministic symbol/import/reference extraction, kept incrementally current by the file watcher. Symbol identity is a content-addressed hash of (project, path, kind, container, name) so references survive a reindex.
issues: All 8 commands have zero frontend callers. The index is actively maintained on every relevant file change but nothing reads it. The editor has no go-to-definition or find-references despite the data existing. This is finding P1-1.

features.name: Semantic embedding index
features.description: Embedding generation, health and nearest-neighbour lookup over memory chunks. Designed to contribute candidates, never to rerank a deterministic result.
issues: All 5 commands have zero frontend callers. The index cannot be configured, populated, cleared or queried by a user. The adjacent knowledge_semantic_health IS called, so the Memory UI displays health for an index nothing can populate.

features.name: Swarm multi-agent execution
features.description: Typed roles, task graph with dependencies, 900 ms scheduler, one PTY and one Git worktree per agent with declared file ownership, structured provider JSONL normalisation, per-swarm operation lock, global concurrency ceiling.
issues: SwarmRuntimeKind::Auto normalises no events (swarm_service.rs:1165), so an Auto agent can neither report completion nor satisfy the completion gate — classified BROKEN.
ProductionAgentRuntime has no direct test coverage; all 43 tests run against SimAdapter.
database/swarm.rs (2538 LOC) has no mod tests.

features.name: Swarm completion gate
features.description: A task reporting success is vetoed unless persisted evidence exists: Integrator and test-named Builder tasks require a passing swarm_test_records row; Reviewer tasks require their own passing test record AND a verified evidence row authored by that agent.
issues: swarm_evidence.payload_json is hardcoded to '{}' on insert (database/swarm.rs:1547) and SwarmEvidence has no payload field, so the gate can verify that evidence exists but never what it says.
The Builder requirement is a task-title substring match on 'test'/'verify'/'regression' (swarm_service.rs:4216), so an ordinarily-named Builder task has no verification requirement.

features.name: Agent run → handoff → durable knowledge
features.description: A finished Swarm agent run is turned into a structured handoff (never fabricating a field: a run with no tests reports no tests), which an ExtractHandoff job converts into knowledge candidates under the same deterministic policy as everything else.
issues: Fires only from swarm_service.rs:4311. An agent the user launches in a terminal pane produces no handoff and no knowledge — finding P1-8.

features.name: Orchestration Kernel
features.description: Durable orchestration sessions with a validated lifecycle state machine, a typed capability registry, a risk/approval policy gate, and I/O redaction before persistence or emission.
issues: Only 6 capabilities exist: project.list, workspace.list, terminal.list, setting.read, file.read, file.write.
No model invocation anywhere. orchestrator_send_message persists a turn and emits transcript_updated; it triggers no work.
Only pause/resume/cancel are exposed, so 11 of 14 declared states are unreachable.
The UI offers observe/assist/execute/autopilot modes that no backend code reads — UI-ONLY.
It duplicates the Swarm engine's domain without working. This is finding P0-2.

features.name: Claude and Codex usage tracking
features.description: Real provider quota. Codex is read by spawning `codex -s read-only -a untrusted app-server` and speaking its JSON protocol; cumulative counters become deltas and windows are classified by duration, not position. Unavailable providers return typed statuses, never invented numbers.
tests: src-tauri/src/services/usage_service.rs (8 tests incl. malformed and negative data)
issues: Cost estimation uses a hardcoded frontend pricing table (usagePricing.ts) that will silently drift from vendor pricing.

features.name: Signed auto-update with recovery
features.description: Journalled update lifecycle; minisign signature verification with a per-edition pubkey compiled into the binary; pre-migration database backup; post-update health confirmation; recovery mode with staged backup restore and safe mode.
issues: No real download/install integration test.
The Preview edition is fully implemented but has no publishing workflow, so it cannot ship.

features.name: Notification centre / toasts / OS notifications
features.description: Not implemented. The only cross-cutting user-attention mechanism is sidebar attention routing; every other signal (swarm attention, repository approvals, knowledge conflicts, update availability) surfaces only within its own route.
issues: Verified absent: no toast system, no notification centre, no tauri-plugin-notification dependency, no persisted notifications, no unread state. This is finding P2-1.

features.name: Global command palette and shortcut registry
features.description: Not implemented. All keyboard handlers are surface-local: Ctrl+, and Ctrl+Shift+G in WorkspaceScreen; Ctrl+P and Ctrl+Shift+S in CodeSurface; Ctrl+L/R/+/-/0 in BrowserSurface; Ctrl+S in MemoryEditor.
issues: 7 of 11 routes have no keyboard entry point. This is finding P2-2.

features.name: Mission Control
features.description: Does not exist in this build. There is no mission route, screen, store, composer or live table. Only orphaned schema (missions, mission_sessions, mission_tasks) remains from an earlier design.
issues: mission_tasks is worse than dead: database/repository.rs:475 validates every repository audit task_id against it, so valid_task is always NULL and audit provenance is silently discarded. This is finding P0-4.

note: This file carries the representative and highest-signal entries with full field detail. The exhaustive 118-feature inventory, including every small feature, is 02-FEATURE-CATALOG.md; the per-dimension classification is 03-FEATURE-MATURITY-MATRIX.md.
